events.text: The mission was established by the Franciscan order.
events.subject: self
events.quote: It was established on July 25 , 1797 by the Franciscan order

events.text: The church reopened after being closed to the public for six years.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the church reopened on September 29 , 2009

events.text: The mission was put on the National Register of Historic Places.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The mission was put on the National Register of Historic Places in 1971

events.text: The mission was named to a National Historic Landmark.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was named to a National Historic Landmark in 2006

events.text: Father Fermín Lasuén and Father Buenaventura Sitjar founded the mission.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Father Fermín Lasuén and Father Buenaventura Sitjar founded the mission on July 25 , 1797

events.text: The small chapel was replaced.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1798 the small chapel was replaced .

events.text: A new church was constructed with a tile roof and courtyard.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From 1816 to 1818 a new church was constructed with a tile roof and courtyard .

events.text: The construction of the new church ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From 1816 to 1818 a new church was constructed with a tile roof and courtyard .

events.text: Mission San Miguel Arcángel land was sold off after the Mexican secularization act.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Mission San Miguel Arcángel land was sold off after the Mexican secularization act of 1833 .

events.text: The William Reed family lived in the buildings until they were murdered.
events.subject: other
events.quote: The William Reed family lived in the buildings until 1848 , when they were murdered by a band of thieves .

events.text: Padre Abella, the last Franciscan at San Miguel, died.
events.subject: other
events.quote: Padre Abella , the last Franciscan at San Miguel , died in July , 1841 .

events.text: The U.S. government returned the mission to the Catholic Church.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1859 the U.S . government returned the mission to the Catholic Church .

events.text: The Church reactivated the mission.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1878 the Church reactivated the mission

events.text: Rev. Philip Farrelly took up residence as First Pastor of Mission San Miguel.
events.subject: other
events.object: First Pastor of Mission San Miguel
events.quote: Rev . Philip Farrelly took up residence as First Pastor of Mission San Miguel .

events.text: The mission was returned to the Franciscan Padres.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1928 the mission was returned to the Franciscan Padres

events.text: The first chapel on the site was replaced within a year of its construction by a larger adobe chapel.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The first chapel on the site was replaced within a year of its construction by a larger adobe chapel

events.text: The larger adobe chapel burned in the 1806 fire.
events.subject: self
events.quote: which burned in the 1806 fire

events.text: The current mission church was built starting in 1816.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The current mission church was built between 1816 and 1818

events.text: The building of the current mission church ended in 1818.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The current mission church was built between 1816 and 1818

events.text: The Rios-Caledonia Adobe was built just south of the San Miguel Mission.
events.subject: other
events.quote: The Rios-Caledonia Adobe was built in 1835 just south of the San Miguel Mission

events.text: A building was added that is now a history research library.
events.subject: other
events.quote: A building was added in 1930 that is now a unique history research library
